scope: Selected C copying-GC helpers, interpreter ownership boundary, function/export word layouts, module_info and MD5. This is not whole-file admission.

profile.equality: Native exact term/bitstring comparison for admitted representations; explicit scratch OOM precedes generated eq/ne branches; no loose comparison or ordering admission
profile.local_calls: Verified function-entry labels/arity and continuation frames; generated local/move/tail calls, Y moves/swaps/initialization; private-entry reduction yields use the native function directory and owned MFA copy
profile.shapes: Native tuple/list tests, extraction, cons and tuple-arity tables; proof of shape/minimum arity across both branches, joins, moves, calls and Y roots; compiler hints are not trusted and are removed after proof, before native transformations
profile.arity_tables: Whole generated select_tuple_arity helper and native operand-pair qsort; fallible arena allocation; signed packed label reads use memcpy without word-array aliasing
profile.analysis_limits: 64 MiB temporary proof workspace released before load completion; at most 256 distinct tuple arities per selector; no density, quota or latency guarantee
profile.addition: Native small/bignum/finite-float addition; whole plus/increment groups and increment generator; fallible scratch before collection, preserved heap credit, repaired Y destinations and OOM checked before guard failure; scoped default IEEE environment; numeric-sources.json
profile.writable_initialization: Whole native bs_init_writable dispatch; allocating-frame proof, native capacity defaults, owned initialized storage, fallible publication, per-attempt/GC work charge, post-publication yields and explicit process/task/world infrastructure limits; writable-init-sources.json
profile.binary_construction: Complete native i_bs_create_bin dispatch; full-kind sizing/storage dependencies, whole generated writer branches, checked Live/Y roots, private consumption and runtime alias refusal, late destination publication, rooted error payloads, conservative work charging and post-instruction yields; binary-build-sources.json. Installed ARM JIT UTF8 error ordering differs from the pinned interpreter; no trace/catch-unwind admission. Bounded local matching is recorded separately below.
profile.local_funs: Native local-fun layouts and module-local lambda entries, module leases, environment GC/copy/equality, whole make_fun3/call_fun2 generators and native construction/call dispatch. Captured, nested and closed guest closures execute on the worker. Lambda targets/arity/indexes are verified before emission; literal operand sites retain defining code before instruction effects. Badfun/badarity and code retention through moving collection and saved continuations are tested. Native is_function predicates execute through whole nonallocating BIF body/guard dispatch groups, with eager positive linking. Native get/element loader generators are retained to complete those transform cases; dictionary effects, composite dictionary hashes and element effects remain unadmitted. Native spawn/3 admits unmonitored erlang:apply(F,[]) startup for owned local fun/0 only, with task storage before child preparation, copied roots/code/PID before runnable publication and world-stop physical draining. Other valid MFAs/apply shapes return infrastructure REFUSED; malformed atoms/proper-list inputs retain native badarg. Heavy BIF epilogues propagate infrastructure REFUSED/ENVIRONMENT separately from guest errors. External/unloaded fun effects remain unadmitted. Protected ordinary-BEAM spawn/1 and spawn_monitor/1 wrappers and owned local monitors are recorded separately below.
profile.frame_trim: Proven drop/remaining counts and transferred Y definitions/shapes; unchanged native trim and two-register move window
profile.native_kind: heavy; these owned implementations may collect
profile.native_continuation: Only integer_to_binary/1 retains typed process-owned scratch across native trampoline yields. Native schoolbook formatting is selected directly; no incomplete D&C wrapper or dirty scheduler. Process destruction frees pending state; decimal-sources.json
profile.identity: Namespace-owned native PTAB directory and internal PID terms; self/0 and is_pid/1 execute with stable identities, stale-generation checks, fallible lazy initialization and logical-exit removal. Persistent local actors execute on the shared worker; broader signals remain pending; process-identity-sources.json.
profile.threading: explicit-context bounded executor; one lazy joinable POSIX worker per Engine; Engine mutex serializes raw loader/heap/domain access; no tenant TLS
profile.literals: bounded ETF subset plus ordinary immutable offheap binaries (binary-sources.json); empty/single-entry MAP_EXT flatmaps; no ETF fun or larger-map admission
profile.message_storage: Native message-reference prefix, self-contained heap-fragment/offheap storage and inner-queue pointer cursors; independent embedded-fun module leases and namespace roots; prepare before enqueue, exact allocation-prefix rollback, selective cursor/tail removal and process-destructor draining. Whole native send dispatch now executes the positive local-internal-PID branch using prepared owned fragments, namespace-relative lookup, real sender identity and tail publication. Dead local PIDs drop the message and return it; invalid destination terms yield badarg; registered names resolve locally; external destinations refuse the runtime profile. Infrastructure OOM/LIMIT/REFUSED remain separate, and completed sends yield at the successor without replay. Terminal exit/destruction drains queued fragments. Native move_trim_yxt and move2_par_xxxy fusions retain their whole cases after original move/trim dataflow verification. Actor-heap message import now prepares heap capacity and embedded-fun leases, copies through a temporary offheap chain, and publishes only after exact copy completion; failure clears temporary references and new code-lease prefixes. Tests destroy the immutable source, collect the importing actor and execute the copied closure from an independent child. Selective matching helpers now cache one actor-owned view in a dedicated moving-GC root, avoid re-import/replay across repeated peeks, distinguish empty queue from infrastructure failure, advance past unmatched nodes without deletion, reset the cursor after consumption, and clear the borrowed node before unlink. Tests collect with zero X roots while matching, preserve skipped messages, append at an exhausted cursor, and drain the cached view during process destruction. Whole native loop_rec, loop_rec_end, remove_message, timeout and shared wait groups now execute with actor-owned matching views. Native literal-timeout generators retain their complete cases. Flow proof tracks matching state across joins, requires initialized Y roots, drops dead X facts at scanning/waiting boundaries and rejects dynamic timeout operands. Serialized local-only queues have no outer/distribution signal producer; external decoding refuses rather than dropping messages. Unadmitted tracing/probe branches are excluded with an explicit NIL-token boundary. Native delay-GC flags do not cross schedule-out; matching views reload from the registered actor root. Worker scheduling excludes waiting actors; local send wakes only after publication. Owned monotonic receive deadlines have no external actor callbacks and are polled during timed idle waits; this is not a transplanted native timer wheel or a hard latency guarantee. Worker tests execute repeated correlated requests against a persistent guest actor, preserve an unmatched message, expire a receive timeout, fault copied-closure send/import allocations, make peer progress and physically drain waiting children on stop. The existing persistent actor retains its wrapped-reference protocol; a new worker request uses compiler-emitted plain-reference marker reserve/bind/use/clear. All four complete native marker cases execute through an owned eight-slot block with stable copied ordinary-reference payloads. Circular index reuse and tail-position anchors replace native non-message insertion/signal-lock interleavings in the serialized inner-only queue. Unlink repairs all borrowed anchors before releasing a preceding node; stale/unknown references do not change save. Tests exercise allocation prefixes, slot reuse, zero-X-root GC and predecessor/tail removal. This grants no outer/prioq/distribution marker capability. Registered local names now resolve through the namespace registry; missing names produce native badarg, with the same fragment preparation/publication/wakeup as PID send. Owned local monitors and kill delivery execute; broader signals and general timer services remain unadmitted. Message preparation freezes nested writable backing before copying, including binaries inside captured fun environments.
profile.binary_matching: Native ErlSubBits MATCH_CONTEXT header/flags and ordinary heap/BinRef origin roots; whole start_match3, ensure/read/extract/eq/tail dispatch groups and complete bs_match generator. Flow admits ensure-at-least/exactly, unsigned big-endian small integers and equality packets up to 63 packed bits, plus sparse two-small-value selectors. Context/noncontext joins retain a possible-context poison; moves/GC preserve cursors but calls, containers and guest-value consumers refuse them. Moving heap-origin contexts repair cached base after GC; BinRef origins remain offheap rooted. Native bitdata survives instruction-budget safepoints. Other generator branches grant no execution authority; binary extraction, signed/little-endian matching, dense/general selectors and interprocedural context arguments remain unadmitted. Private-append comprehension still lacks entry facts.
profile.preloaded_and_monitors: Compile complete pinned erlang.erl spawn/1, spawn_monitor/1 and badarg helper into ordinary BEAM; protected world bootstrap with native-self-import fallback, no BIF aliases. Native monitor-node/data prefixes and circular half lists own copied ordinary references under Engine serialization. Prepare both halves before runnable publication; normal/killed DOWN copies before enqueue, demonitor/2 flush repairs cursors/anchors, private cancellation detaches without fabricated DOWN. Infrastructure failures propagate as infrastructure through monitors. Error-class DOWN now materializes real function/argument/continuation traces through the native capture/build algorithm, with pinned default depth 8 and the existing explicit no-line-info policy. Snapshot code metadata before GC, reserve before borrowing raw arglist/error-info, build native tuple4 frames and copy the expanded reason/trace into DOWN. Terminal heap/stack/PC publication precedes monitor capture; interpreter aliases reload after collection. Tests require actual MFA/argument/error-info and non-tail continuation frames, including BIF badarg and every allocation prefix. Native BIF cause maps beyond the positive catalog, info options, aliases, distribution and non-kill exit/2 remain unadmitted; no raw saved-ftrace bignum or catch/unwind admission.
profile.registered_names: Native register.c atom-index hash/equality, HashBucket/RegProc prefix and hash.c Fibonacci/chained buckets, with fixed owned bucket storage and Engine serialization replacing global lock/retry paths. Allocate registry/association before publication; reject duplicate name, already registered/dead process, undefined or malformed arguments with badarg. Logical exit/destruction removes the name before PID retirement and frees an empty registry. Ports remain unadmitted. Worker tests execute registered-name receive, allocation-prefix rollback, duplicate/missing-name errors and exact registry/queue/PID cleanup.
profile.guest_errors: Complete error/1 body and error/3 option scan plus native error/2 fallback; reserve before borrowing moving operands, preserve class/flags and raw arglist/error-info payload separately from the expanded reason, and report allocation/limit failures as infrastructure. Uncaught monitor errors have immediate trace materialization under the explicit no-line-info policy; no saved-ftrace/catch/unwind admission. MAP_EXT literal production is limited to empty/single-entry native flatmaps, which need no key sorter or duplicate collapse; larger maps and HAMT remain unadmitted. Worker error-info fixtures fault every allocation prefix before the first genuine guest exception.
profile.engine: Owned shared native catalog and allocation substrate; C worlds and tasks retain Engine through physical retirement; worker-side orphan/space retirement and host lifetime checks share the mutex; final join follows host unlock
profile.host_protocol: C world/call/reclamation ownership and thin C++ adapter; copied binary input/output, reserved capacity, once-only completion and physical selected-world retirement; the host protocol itself adds no opcode or BIF capabilities
profile.remaining: Full loader/opcode/native-service breadth remains outstanding. Unchanged lifecycle and stateful two-Isolate acceptance pass Debug/Release/UBSan; shared-worker churn, boot fault prefixes, queued retirement, GC and detached reply ownership are covered. Broader exception/signal semantics, line locations and catch/unwind remain unadmitted; this is not general Erlang/Elixir support.
